assumptions.description_zh: 当前使用基于公告文字描述估算的临时边界，非官方精确测量polygon
assumptions.description_en: Current boundaries are provisional estimates based on public text description, not official surveyed polygons
assumptions.impact: 所有面积计算、空间分析均为近似值，待官方边界发布后需重算
assumptions.resolution_plan: 官方GeoJSON边界发布后重新生成所有几何图层和指标

assumptions.description_zh: 缺少官方控规条件：容积率、建筑高度、建筑密度、退线、道路红线等
assumptions.description_en: Missing official planning controls: FAR, building heights, setbacks, road red lines
assumptions.impact: 不给出具体管控指标数值，所有建筑规模和强度建议为概念性
assumptions.resolution_plan: 控规条件发布后补充管控指标

assumptions.description_zh: 缺少现状建筑测绘数据、权属数据、质量评定数据
assumptions.description_en: Missing existing building survey, ownership, and quality assessment data
assumptions.impact: 拆改留方案仅为原则性建议，不给出具体拆留建议
assumptions.resolution_plan: 获取现状建筑数据后更新建筑图层和更新策略

assumptions.description_zh: 缺少市政管线、交通流量、防洪、文保、地质等工程数据
assumptions.description_en: Missing municipal utilities, traffic, flood control, heritage preservation, and geotechnical data
assumptions.impact: 市政和交通方案为系统性概念建议，不给出工程实施细节
assumptions.resolution_plan: 工程专项深化阶段补充

assumptions.description_zh: 运营主体、资金来源、实施时序均为概念建议，无政府承诺
assumptions.description_en: Operating entities, funding sources, and phasing are conceptual suggestions with no government commitment
assumptions.impact: 商业模式和分期为建议性框架
assumptions.resolution_plan: 实施阶段由相关方协商确定
